questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A regulated financial services company has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for AWS Global Infrastructure. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use multiple AWS Regions with Regional service endpoints, data replication, and Route 53 or Global Accelerator routing based on latency and recovery requirements
Skip permission boundaries when delegating IAM administration to development teams
Use IAM password policy to enforce VPC routing decisions
Use S3 server-side encryption only when the bucket is publicly accessible

explanations.a: A multi-Region design can place workloads closer to users and provide Regional failure isolation when data and routing are designed together.
explanations.b: Without permission boundaries, delegated admins can grant themselves higher privileges than intended.
explanations.c: IAM password policy governs human credentials; VPC routing lives in route tables.
explanations.d: SSE should be enabled by default for all buckets; public access is unrelated to whether to encrypt at rest.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A media platform is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy AWS Global Infrastructure. What change should be made?

answers.text: Use AWS Budgets to enforce IAM permission boundaries on engineering teams
Choose Availability Zones within the selected Region for high availability, while reserving multi-Region design for disaster recovery or global latency needs
Connect on-premises with only a single Site-to-Site VPN tunnel for production
Place all traffic through one unmanaged appliance in one Availability Zone

explanations.a: Budgets alert on cost; permission boundaries are an IAM construct.
explanations.b: Availability Zones protect against zonal failures inside a Region without adding the operational complexity of active multi-Region operation.
explanations.c: Single-tunnel VPN has no failover; AWS recommends two tunnels per VPN connection plus DX or a second VPN for resilience.
explanations.d: A single appliance in one AZ is a single point of failure; deploy across AZs with health checks.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A retail organization must choose between several AWS architecture patterns for AWS Global Infrastructure. Which option best satisfies the requirement?

answers.text: Use a single shared Internet Gateway across multiple VPCs by sharing it via AWS RAM
Use AWS Config rules to grant additional IAM permissions to roles
Place latency-sensitive components in the Region closest to the largest user population and use edge services for global content delivery
Skip AWS Organizations and manage accounts independently with email-based invoices

explanations.a: Internet Gateways are not shareable resources in AWS RAM; each VPC has its own IGW.
explanations.b: Config rules audit; they cannot grant or change permissions.
explanations.c: Regional placement and edge delivery reduce round trips while keeping the origin architecture manageable.
explanations.d: Independent accounts forfeit consolidated billing, SCPs, and centralized governance.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A fast-growing startup has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for AWS Global Infrastructure. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use IAM password policy as the authoritative identity provider for federated users
Skip Route 53 Resolver inbound and outbound endpoints for hybrid DNS
Skip cross-account event notifications and rely on per-account email subscriptions
Use Local Zones, Wavelength, or Outposts only when workload latency or residency requirements justify those infrastructure options

explanations.a: IAM password policy governs IAM user passwords, not federated identities; federation uses SAML/OIDC IdPs.
explanations.b: Hybrid DNS resolution between on-prem and VPCs requires Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints with rules.
explanations.c: Per-account email creates noise and gaps; central EventBridge bus or SNS aggregation is the recommended pattern.
explanations.d: Specialized infrastructure should be selected when standard Regions and Availability Zones cannot meet the business requirement.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for AWS Global Infrastructure after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Model Regional dependencies, service availability, and data residency before committing to the target Regions
Use a single-AZ deployment to reduce inter-AZ data transfer charges and improve resiliency
Use AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations only after manual application by every team
Place customer gateway IP inside the VPC CIDR range

explanations.a: Professional architecture decisions must account for service availability, legal constraints, and operational dependencies across Regions.
explanations.b: Single-AZ saves traffic costs but eliminates HA; resiliency requires multi-AZ.
explanations.c: Compute Optimizer integrates with automation; ignoring its recommendations defeats the rightsizing purpose.
explanations.d: The customer gateway must be a public or routable IP outside the VPC CIDR; overlap breaks tunnel routing.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A public sector agency is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on AWS networking concepts. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

answers.text: Use AWS WAF as a layer 4 firewall for non-HTTP TCP traffic
Use Transit Gateway for scalable hub-and-spoke routing with segmented route tables
Set RTO to zero by relying on backup and restore as the only DR strategy
Use Spot Instances for the entire stateful database tier to reduce compute cost

explanations.a: WAF inspects HTTP/HTTPS only; layer 4 protection comes from security groups, NACLs, or Network Firewall.
explanations.b: Transit Gateway provides centralized routing and segmentation for many VPCs and hybrid attachments.
explanations.c: Backup and restore has the highest RTO/RPO; near-zero RTO requires warm standby or multi-site active-active.
explanations.d: Spot capacity can be reclaimed at any time; stateful databases need predictable, persistent compute.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports AWS networking concepts in a complex organization?

answers.text: Use scale-up only on a single EC2 instance to handle unpredictable traffic spikes
Use AWS Config rules as a substitute for IAM policy enforcement
Use AWS Direct Connect with redundant connections for predictable private hybrid bandwidth
Disable VPC Flow Logs and rely on application logs alone for network forensics

explanations.a: Vertical scaling alone has hard ceilings and a single point of failure; combine with horizontal scaling and Auto Scaling.
explanations.b: Config rules detect drift and noncompliance; IAM policies are the actual authorization gate.
explanations.c: Direct Connect is designed for dedicated private connectivity when throughput and consistency matter.
explanations.d: App logs cannot reconstruct dropped packets, port scans, or layer 3/4 anomalies that flow logs capture.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A multinational enterprise is preparing a target architecture for a complex AWS organization. Which recommendation best addresses AWS networking concepts?

answers.text: Use IAM users with shared passwords across the engineering team
Use Amazon EBS snapshots as a substitute for a multi-Region Aurora Global Database
Use AWS Health Dashboard as a real-time intrusion detection engine
Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN for encrypted hybrid connectivity when internet-based tunnels meet the performance and availability goals

explanations.a: Shared credentials destroy traceability and violate every IAM best practice; use IAM Identity Center or federation.
explanations.b: EBS snapshots protect block volumes; cross-Region database availability requires Aurora Global Database or DMS.
explanations.c: Health Dashboard reports AWS service and account health; intrusion detection is GuardDuty.
explanations.d: Site-to-Site VPN provides IPsec connectivity without requiring a dedicated physical circuit.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A healthcare SaaS provider is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on AWS networking concepts. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

answers.text: Use VPC peering only for simple nontransitive connectivity between non-overlapping VPCs
Replace AWS Organizations with manually emailed shared spreadsheets of account IDs
Use IAM roles in place of resource policies for cross-account S3 access
Use AWS Service Catalog as a packet-inspection firewall

explanations.a: VPC peering is efficient for a small number of direct VPC connections but does not provide transitive routing.
explanations.b: Manual spreadsheets cannot enforce SCPs, billing aggregation, or cross-account governance.
explanations.c: Cross-account S3 access typically requires both: a role with s3 actions and a bucket policy granting cross-account principals.
explanations.d: Service Catalog publishes approved IT products; it is unrelated to network traffic inspection.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for AWS networking concepts after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Use Amazon Macie to continuously block all data at rest from leaving the account
Use container networking mode and service discovery choices that match the ECS or EKS deployment model
Use long-lived IAM access keys embedded in EC2 user data for cross-account access
Use AWS Backup as a network configuration drift detection tool

explanations.a: Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in S3; blocking exfiltration is done by SCPs, S3 Block Public Access, and VPC endpoints.
explanations.b: Container services can consume VPC IPs and expose services differently, so networking must be part of the architecture.
explanations.c: Long-lived keys violate least privilege and rotation; use IAM roles assumed via STS or instance profiles.
explanations.d: AWS Backup protects data; network drift detection is AWS Config.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: During architecture approval, the review board asks how the design will scale across accounts and Regions while preserving control over hybrid DNS concepts. What should be recommended?

answers.text: Use AWS Trusted Advisor as a packet-capture and forensic investigation tool
Use overlapping CIDR ranges across all VPCs and let routing protocols resolve conflicts
Use Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints for on-premises queries to AWS private hosted zones
Disable AWS Shield Standard to reduce baseline latency

explanations.a: Trusted Advisor is a best-practice advisor for cost, security, and limits; not a forensic tool.
explanations.b: AWS does not arbitrate overlapping CIDRs; address conflicts must be designed out before connecting VPCs.
explanations.c: Inbound endpoints let corporate DNS forward selected AWS private namespaces into the VPC resolver path.
explanations.d: Shield Standard is included free for all AWS customers and cannot be disabled.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A media platform has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for hybrid DNS concepts. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use AWS DataSync to provide live SQL replication between two RDS Aurora clusters
Replace AWS WAF with security groups for SQL injection protection
Use a single VPC peering connection to provide transitive routing through a hub VPC
Use Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoints with forwarding rules for AWS workloads that need on-premises names

explanations.a: DataSync is for file/object data migration; live SQL replication uses Aurora Global Database or DMS.
explanations.b: Security groups are layer 3/4 filters and do not inspect HTTP payloads; WAF is the L7 control.
explanations.c: VPC peering is non-transitive; spoke VPCs cannot reach each other through a hub via peering alone.
explanations.d: Outbound endpoints send selected VPC resolver queries to corporate DNS servers.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A retail organization is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy hybrid DNS concepts. What change should be made?

answers.text: Define authoritative DNS ownership and conditional forwarding boundaries to avoid resolver loops
Use Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall to authenticate API Gateway requests
Use a single shared AWS account for production, dev, and audit logs to simplify access
Use AWS Snowball as the recommended ongoing data transfer mechanism for daily backups

explanations.a: Hybrid DNS needs clear suffix ownership so queries do not bounce between environments.
explanations.b: DNS Firewall filters outbound DNS queries; API authentication uses IAM, Cognito, or Lambda authorizers.
explanations.c: Single-account designs blur blast radius and audit boundaries; production/dev/audit should be separate accounts.
explanations.d: Snowball is for one-time bulk transfers; ongoing daily transfer uses DataSync, Storage Gateway, or DX.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports hybrid DNS concepts in a complex organization?

answers.text: Skip TLS in transit because IPsec already encrypts at layer 3
Associate private hosted zones with every VPC that must resolve the private namespace
Use Multi-AZ RDS as a sufficient disaster recovery strategy across Regions
Use AWS Cost Explorer to provision EC2 capacity in advance

explanations.a: IPsec ends at the tunnel termination; defense in depth still recommends TLS for application traffic.
explanations.b: Private hosted zone visibility follows VPC association, including cross-account associations when configured.
explanations.c: Multi-AZ provides AZ failover within a Region; cross-Region DR requires read replicas, snapshot copy, or Aurora Global Database.
explanations.d: Cost Explorer reports historical and forecasted spend; capacity provisioning uses EC2/ASG/Capacity Reservations.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for hybrid DNS concepts after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics alone without alarms to drive operational response
Use AWS Cost Explorer without enabling cost-allocation tags or Cost and Usage Reports
Centralize Resolver rules and share them to spoke VPCs when multiple accounts require consistent hybrid DNS behavior
Use a single self-managed CA on EC2 instead of ACM Private CA for internal certs

explanations.a: Metrics need alarms (and notifications) to trigger response; dashboards alone are passive.
explanations.b: Without tags or CUR, Cost Explorer cannot break down spend by team, project, or environment.
explanations.c: Shared Resolver rules reduce drift in large multi-account environments.
explanations.d: ACM PCA integrates natively with AWS services and offers managed lifecycle; self-managed CAs add operational burden.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A public sector agency is preparing a target architecture for a complex AWS organization. Which recommendation best addresses network segmentation?

answers.text: Use the AWS Health Dashboard to enforce least-privilege IAM policies
Use AWS Outposts as the recommended global CDN for static content
Skip cross-Region replication for S3 data classified as critical for regulatory continuity
Separate trust zones with distinct VPCs or subnets, explicit route tables, security groups, and network ACLs

explanations.a: Health Dashboard reports operational events; IAM policies enforce permissions.
explanations.b: Outposts brings AWS infrastructure on-premises; global CDN is CloudFront.
explanations.c: Critical regulated data typically requires cross-Region replication so a Region outage does not lose recoverability.
explanations.d: Segmentation works when routing and security controls both reflect the intended trust boundary.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A global analytics company is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on network segmentation. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

answers.text: Use Transit Gateway route tables to prevent production, development, and shared-services attachments from learning unintended routes
Disable AWS CloudTrail organization trail to reduce logging costs
Use AWS Config to capture per-packet flow data
Skip resource tagging and identify cost owners by manually inspecting every resource each month

explanations.a: Transit Gateway association and propagation scope can enforce network separation at scale.
explanations.b: Disabling CloudTrail removes audit visibility; an organization trail is the standard governance baseline.
explanations.c: Config tracks resource configuration changes, not network packet data.
explanations.d: Cost allocation tags are the supported mechanism; manual review does not scale and produces inconsistent allocation.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A multinational enterprise needs a professional-level design that balances governance, resiliency, and operations for network segmentation. Which approach is best?

answers.text: Use ACM-imported public certs without renewal monitoring or alerting
Avoid overlapping CIDRs during account and VPC planning, and use IPAM or governed CIDR allocation
Use full-mesh VPC peering to scale to dozens of VPCs across accounts
Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection without configuring alert subscriptions

explanations.a: Imported certs do not auto-renew; expiry causes outages without explicit monitoring.
explanations.b: Address governance prevents later routing conflicts and complex translation work.
explanations.c: Full-mesh peering scales as O(n^2) and quickly hits operational limits; Transit Gateway is the scalable hub.
explanations.d: Without subscribers, anomaly findings go unread; alerts must route to email, Slack, or SNS.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A healthcare SaaS provider is preparing a target architecture for a complex AWS organization. Which recommendation best addresses network segmentation?

answers.text: Use a NAT gateway as a stateful inspection firewall for east-west traffic
Use a public VIF on Direct Connect to reach private VPC subnets
Expose shared services through PrivateLink when consumers need service access without broad network reachability
Use AWS Organizations as a routing protocol between VPCs

explanations.a: NAT gateways translate addresses and do not inspect or filter east-west VPC traffic.
explanations.b: Public VIFs reach AWS public service endpoints, not private VPC IP space; that requires private or transit VIFs.
explanations.c: PrivateLink limits consumers to a service endpoint rather than a provider VPC CIDR.
explanations.d: AWS Organizations governs accounts and policies, not packet routing.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for network segmentation after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Use Service Control Policies to grant additional permissions beyond IAM
Grant the AdministratorAccess managed policy to all developer roles for productivity
Rely on manual spreadsheets as the enforcement mechanism
Place inspection VPCs on required north-south and east-west paths and remove bypass routes

explanations.a: SCPs only restrict the maximum allowed permissions; they cannot grant access that IAM does not.
explanations.b: Wide-open admin grants violate least privilege; scope policies to required actions and resources.
explanations.c: Manual spreadsheets do not enforce configuration; controls must live in IAM, SCPs, or Config rules.
explanations.d: Central inspection provides value only when route tables force traffic through the control point.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports network traffic monitoring in a complex organization?

answers.text: Enable VPC Flow Logs, Transit Gateway Flow Logs, and load balancer access logs for the relevant traffic boundaries
Use AWS Control Tower without enrolling existing accounts to skip baseline controls
Use a public hosted zone to serve only VPC-internal DNS queries
Use Reserved Instances purchased in one OU to cover all OUs without sharing

explanations.a: Different log sources cover different layers, so boundary-based logging improves troubleshooting and auditability.
explanations.b: Unenrolled accounts bypass mandatory controls; enrollment is required for landing zone consistency.
explanations.c: Public hosted zones are authoritative on the internet; VPC-only resolution requires a private hosted zone.
explanations.d: RI sharing must be enabled in Organizations billing settings; otherwise discounts apply only to the purchasing account.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: During architecture approval, the review board asks how the design will scale across accounts and Regions while preserving control over network traffic monitoring. What should be recommended?

answers.text: Use Network ACLs as a stateful application-layer firewall
Use Traffic Mirroring only for scoped packet-level investigations that require payload or header inspection
Use Amazon CloudFront cache settings to control inter-VPC routing
Use only On-Demand pricing for stable 24/7 production workloads to maximize flexibility

explanations.a: Network ACLs are stateless and operate at layers 3/4; they do not understand application protocols.
explanations.b: Mirroring can capture packets but must be scoped because it can collect sensitive data and high volume.
explanations.c: CloudFront cache controls edge caching, not VPC routing or hybrid traffic flow.
explanations.d: Stable 24/7 workloads benefit most from Reserved Instances or Savings Plans; On-Demand is the costliest option.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A retail organization has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for network traffic monitoring. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use AWS Direct Connect SiteLink as a replacement for Transit Gateway intra-Region peering
Use AWS Auto Scaling without health checks so unhealthy instances stay in service
Deliver network logs to a central account with consistent partitioning, retention, and query access
Use an S3 Lifecycle rule as the network control

explanations.a: SiteLink provides any-to-any connectivity between Direct Connect locations; intra-Region VPC-to-VPC uses TGW or peering.
explanations.b: Without health checks, ASG cannot replace failed instances; HA depends on health-driven replacement.
explanations.c: Centralized delivery improves cross-account analysis and protects evidence from workload administrators.
explanations.d: S3 Lifecycle manages object class transitions; it has no effect on network reachability or traffic.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A fast-growing startup is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy network traffic monitoring. What change should be made?

answers.text: Use the AWS Pricing Calculator as a real-time billing alarm system
Use Amazon Cognito identity pools as a replacement for AWS Organizations SCPs
Use IAM session policies to expand a role beyond its attached permissions
Create CloudWatch alarms and dashboards from native metrics and log-derived metrics for critical network paths

explanations.a: Pricing Calculator is for pre-purchase estimation; real-time alarms come from AWS Budgets and CloudWatch.
explanations.b: Cognito provides end-user identities; SCPs are organization-level guardrails for AWS API actions.
explanations.c: Session policies further restrict; they cannot grant beyond what the role already has.
explanations.d: Operations teams need threshold-based signals, not just raw logs.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for multiple VPC connectivity options after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Select Transit Gateway when many VPCs need hub routing, segmentation, or shared inspection
Use AWS Trusted Advisor as a packet-capture utility
Use AWS Backup without vault lock to satisfy ransomware-resistant retention
Use VPC interface endpoints to expose internal services to the public internet

explanations.a: Transit Gateway reduces peering sprawl and supports route-table segmentation.
explanations.b: Trusted Advisor is a best-practice checker, not a packet-capture tool.
explanations.c: Without vault lock (compliance mode), retention can be modified; vault lock provides the immutability ransomware controls require.
explanations.d: Interface endpoints provide private connectivity into AWS; public exposure uses ALB/NLB or PrivateLink-as-provider.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A fast-growing startup is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy multiple VPC connectivity options. What change should be made?

answers.text: Use AWS PrivateLink to provide transitive routing between three VPCs
Select VPC peering for a small number of direct nontransitive VPC connections with non-overlapping CIDRs
Open all security groups to 0.0.0.0/0 to avoid routing work
Use Direct Connect public VIFs to terminate Site-to-Site VPN tunnels

explanations.a: PrivateLink exposes specific service endpoints, not full IP-level reachability.
explanations.b: Peering is simple and low overhead when the topology stays small and direct.
explanations.c: Open-to-internet security groups expose every service; the correct approach is least-privilege ingress.
explanations.d: VPN tunnels terminate at virtual private gateways or Transit Gateways, not on a DX public VIF.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: An enterprise platform team must choose between several AWS architecture patterns for multiple VPC connectivity options. Which option best satisfies the requirement?

answers.text: Centralize all CloudTrail logs in the management account directly
Use Reserved Instances purchased for one Region to cover usage in a different Region
Select PrivateLink when consumers need private access to a specific provider service without VPC-wide reachability
Use a single S3 bucket without versioning as the backup strategy

explanations.a: Best practice is a dedicated log-archive account with CloudTrail organization trail; the management account should not host logs.
explanations.b: Standard RIs are scoped to a Region (or Availability Zone); use convertible/regional RIs or Savings Plans for flexibility.
explanations.c: PrivateLink is service-oriented and avoids exposing the full provider network.
explanations.d: Without versioning, accidental overwrites or deletes are unrecoverable; enable versioning and lifecycle.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports multiple VPC connectivity options in a complex organization?

answers.text: Use AWS Shield Standard subscriptions to access the Shield Response Team (SRT)
Use AWS IAM Identity Center without an external IdP and rely only on local users
Use AWS Resource Access Manager to share root user credentials across accounts
Use AWS RAM to share supported networking resources such as Transit Gateway or subnets across accounts

explanations.a: SRT engagement requires Shield Advanced; Standard is automatic and free with no SRT access.
explanations.b: IAM Identity Center supports an internal directory but enterprises typically integrate an external IdP for SSO.
explanations.c: AWS RAM shares specific resource types (subnets, TGW, RAM-supported services); root credentials are never shared.
explanations.d: Resource sharing supports centralized ownership while allowing application account participation.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A media platform is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy multiple VPC connectivity options. What change should be made?

answers.text: Segment shared services, production, and development with separate route tables and controlled propagations
Use AWS Lambda with no concurrency limits as a DDoS mitigation strategy
Use IAM Identity Center permission sets that grant AdministratorAccess to all OUs
Use a single AWS account for every environment to simplify cost reporting

explanations.a: Connectivity options must also preserve organizational security boundaries.
explanations.b: Without concurrency or reserved limits, Lambda invocations can amplify abuse traffic and inflate cost.
explanations.c: Permission sets must follow least privilege per role/OU; uniform admin defeats the multi-account model.
explanations.d: Single-account designs eliminate blast-radius isolation and complicate compliance.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for hybrid connectivity options after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Allow encryption keys to be unmanaged by KMS so any service can decrypt the data
Combine redundant Direct Connect connections with VPN backup when private bandwidth and encrypted resilience are both required
Use AWS Backup vault lock in governance mode to enforce regulatory immutability
Use a single public subnet for all tiers and accounts

explanations.a: Unmanaged keys lose KMS audit, rotation, and key policy controls; use customer managed CMKs.
explanations.b: Direct Connect and VPN can work together to meet throughput, privacy, and failover objectives.
explanations.c: Governance mode allows authorized roles to bypass; compliance mode is required for true regulatory immutability.
explanations.d: Mixing tiers and accounts in one public subnet violates segmentation and least-privilege networking.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A healthcare SaaS provider needs a professional-level design that balances governance, resiliency, and operations for hybrid connectivity options. Which approach is best?

answers.text: Use S3 server-side encryption only when the bucket is publicly accessible
Use IAM password policy to enforce VPC routing decisions
Use Site-to-Site VPN when rapid encrypted connectivity is sufficient and dedicated circuit lead time is not justified
Skip permission boundaries when delegating IAM administration to development teams

explanations.a: SSE should be enabled by default for all buckets; public access is unrelated to whether to encrypt at rest.
explanations.b: IAM password policy governs human credentials; VPC routing lives in route tables.
explanations.c: VPN can be provisioned faster than physical connectivity and provides encrypted tunnels.
explanations.d: Without permission boundaries, delegated admins can grant themselves higher privileges than intended.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A manufacturing company is preparing a target architecture for a complex AWS organization. Which recommendation best addresses hybrid connectivity options?

answers.text: Place all traffic through one unmanaged appliance in one Availability Zone
Connect on-premises with only a single Site-to-Site VPN tunnel for production
Use AWS Budgets to enforce IAM permission boundaries on engineering teams
Use Direct Connect gateway with private or transit VIFs to reach multiple VPCs or transit gateways according to the target architecture

explanations.a: A single appliance in one AZ is a single point of failure; deploy across AZs with health checks.
explanations.b: Single-tunnel VPN has no failover; AWS recommends two tunnels per VPN connection plus DX or a second VPN for resilience.
explanations.c: Budgets alert on cost; permission boundaries are an IAM construct.
explanations.d: Direct Connect gateway helps scale private hybrid connectivity beyond a single VPC.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: During architecture approval, the review board asks how the design will scale across accounts and Regions while preserving control over hybrid connectivity options. What should be recommended?

answers.text: Coordinate BGP prefixes, route filters, and device diversity with colocation or network providers
Use a single shared Internet Gateway across multiple VPCs by sharing it via AWS RAM
Skip AWS Organizations and manage accounts independently with email-based invoices
Use AWS Config rules to grant additional IAM permissions to roles

explanations.a: Hybrid design depends on both AWS resources and external network implementation.
explanations.b: Internet Gateways are not shareable resources in AWS RAM; each VPC has its own IGW.
explanations.c: Independent accounts forfeit consolidated billing, SCPs, and centralized governance.
explanations.d: Config rules audit; they cannot grant or change permissions.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A global analytics company needs a professional-level design that balances governance, resiliency, and operations for hybrid connectivity options. Which approach is best?

answers.text: Skip Route 53 Resolver inbound and outbound endpoints for hybrid DNS
Use AWS DataSync or migration tooling separately from the network path when data transfer semantics are part of the requirement
Skip cross-account event notifications and rely on per-account email subscriptions
Use IAM password policy as the authoritative identity provider for federated users

explanations.a: Hybrid DNS resolution between on-prem and VPCs requires Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints with rules.
explanations.b: Connectivity provides a path, but transfer services handle scheduling, validation, and protocol behavior.
explanations.c: Per-account email creates noise and gaps; central EventBridge bus or SNS aggregation is the recommended pattern.
explanations.d: IAM password policy governs IAM user passwords, not federated identities; federation uses SAML/OIDC IdPs.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for Region and Availability Zone selection after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Use AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations only after manual application by every team
Use a single-AZ deployment to reduce inter-AZ data transfer charges and improve resiliency
Select Regions based on latency, compliance, service availability, data residency, and operational support
Place customer gateway IP inside the VPC CIDR range

explanations.a: Compute Optimizer integrates with automation; ignoring its recommendations defeats the rightsizing purpose.
explanations.b: Single-AZ saves traffic costs but eliminates HA; resiliency requires multi-AZ.
explanations.c: Region choice affects user experience, legal constraints, and available AWS services.
explanations.d: The customer gateway must be a public or routable IP outside the VPC CIDR; overlap breaks tunnel routing.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A fast-growing startup has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for Region and Availability Zone selection. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use AWS WAF as a layer 4 firewall for non-HTTP TCP traffic
Set RTO to zero by relying on backup and restore as the only DR strategy
Use Spot Instances for the entire stateful database tier to reduce compute cost
Spread highly available components across multiple Availability Zones within a Region

explanations.a: WAF inspects HTTP/HTTPS only; layer 4 protection comes from security groups, NACLs, or Network Firewall.
explanations.b: Backup and restore has the highest RTO/RPO; near-zero RTO requires warm standby or multi-site active-active.
explanations.c: Spot capacity can be reclaimed at any time; stateful databases need predictable, persistent compute.
explanations.d: Multi-AZ placement protects workloads from zonal failure.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: An enterprise platform team is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy Region and Availability Zone selection. What change should be made?

answers.text: Use active-active or active-passive multi-Region patterns only when RTO, RPO, or latency requirements justify them
Disable VPC Flow Logs and rely on application logs alone for network forensics
Use AWS Config rules as a substitute for IAM policy enforcement
Use scale-up only on a single EC2 instance to handle unpredictable traffic spikes

explanations.a: Multi-Region architecture adds complexity and should map to explicit business goals.
explanations.b: App logs cannot reconstruct dropped packets, port scans, or layer 3/4 anomalies that flow logs capture.
explanations.c: Config rules detect drift and noncompliance; IAM policies are the actual authorization gate.
explanations.d: Vertical scaling alone has hard ceilings and a single point of failure; combine with horizontal scaling and Auto Scaling.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A regulated financial services company must choose between several AWS architecture patterns for Region and Availability Zone selection. Which option best satisfies the requirement?

Use IAM users with shared passwords across the engineering team
Use Amazon EBS snapshots as a substitute for a multi-Region Aurora Global Database

explanations.a: Health Dashboard reports AWS service and account health; intrusion detection is GuardDuty.
explanations.b: Reducing network distance helps latency-sensitive dependencies.
explanations.c: Shared credentials destroy traceability and violate every IAM best practice; use IAM Identity Center or federation.
explanations.d: EBS snapshots protect block volumes; cross-Region database availability requires Aurora Global Database or DMS.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

Replace AWS Organizations with manually emailed shared spreadsheets of account IDs
Use edge services such as CloudFront or Global Accelerator when global users need better ingress or content delivery performance
Use IAM roles in place of resource policies for cross-account S3 access

explanations.a: Service Catalog publishes approved IT products; it is unrelated to network traffic inspection.
explanations.b: Manual spreadsheets cannot enforce SCPs, billing aggregation, or cross-account governance.
explanations.c: Edge services can improve global access without duplicating every component everywhere.
explanations.d: Cross-account S3 access typically requires both: a role with s3 actions and a bucket policy granting cross-account principals.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

Use AWS Backup as a network configuration drift detection tool
Use Amazon Macie to continuously block all data at rest from leaving the account

explanations.a: Long-lived keys violate least privilege and rotation; use IAM roles assumed via STS or instance profiles.
explanations.b: AWS Backup protects data; network drift detection is AWS Config.
explanations.c: Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in S3; blocking exfiltration is done by SCPs, S3 Block Public Access, and VPC endpoints.
explanations.d: AWS troubleshooting tools can identify whether routing or network controls block a path.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A healthcare SaaS provider is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on traffic flow troubleshooting. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

answers.text: Correlate Transit Gateway route tables, attachment associations, propagations, and Flow Logs when a spoke cannot reach a shared service

Use overlapping CIDR ranges across all VPCs and let routing protocols resolve conflicts
Disable AWS Shield Standard to reduce baseline latency

explanations.a: Transit Gateway issues often involve both hub-side and VPC-side routing.
explanations.b: Trusted Advisor is a best-practice advisor for cost, security, and limits; not a forensic tool.
explanations.c: AWS does not arbitrate overlapping CIDRs; address conflicts must be designed out before connecting VPCs.
explanations.d: Shield Standard is included free for all AWS customers and cannot be disabled.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports traffic flow troubleshooting in a complex organization?

Check return routes and stateful firewall paths when forward traffic appears to succeed but responses fail
Use a single VPC peering connection to provide transitive routing through a hub VPC
Replace AWS WAF with security groups for SQL injection protection

explanations.a: DataSync is for file/object data migration; live SQL replication uses Aurora Global Database or DMS.

explanations.c: VPC peering is non-transitive; spoke VPCs cannot reach each other through a hub via peering alone.
explanations.d: Security groups are layer 3/4 filters and do not inspect HTTP payloads; WAF is the L7 control.

Use AWS Snowball as the recommended ongoing data transfer mechanism for daily backups

explanations.d: Snowball is for one-time bulk transfers; ongoing daily transfer uses DataSync, Storage Gateway, or DX.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: During architecture approval, the review board asks how the design will scale across accounts and Regions while preserving control over traffic flow troubleshooting. What should be recommended?

Use AWS Cost Explorer to provision EC2 capacity in advance

explanations.d: Incorrect DNS answers can look like network failures even when routes are healthy.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for service endpoints for integrations after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics alone without alarms to drive operational response

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A workload review identifies conflicting requirements across security, availability, cost, and team ownership. Which option best supports IAM and IAM Identity Center in a complex organization?

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for IAM and IAM Identity Center after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

answers.text: Grant the AdministratorAccess managed policy to all developer roles for productivity

Use Service Control Policies to grant additional permissions beyond IAM

explanations.c: Manual spreadsheets do not enforce configuration; controls must live in IAM, SCPs, or Config rules.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

Use a public hosted zone to serve only VPC-internal DNS queries

explanations.b: Unenrolled accounts bypass mandatory controls; enrollment is required for landing zone consistency.
explanations.c: Different policy layers address different governance needs.
explanations.d: Public hosted zones are authoritative on the internet; VPC-only resolution requires a private hosted zone.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A retail organization has an existing AWS environment that must be redesigned for IAM and IAM Identity Center. What should the solutions architect recommend?

answers.text: Use Network ACLs as a stateful application-layer firewall
Use Amazon CloudFront cache settings to control inter-VPC routing
Use only On-Demand pricing for stable 24/7 production workloads to maximize flexibility
Use IAM Access Analyzer to identify unintended external or cross-account access

explanations.a: Network ACLs are stateless and operate at layers 3/4; they do not understand application protocols.
explanations.b: CloudFront cache controls edge caching, not VPC routing or hybrid traffic flow.
explanations.c: Stable 24/7 workloads benefit most from Reserved Instances or Savings Plans; On-Demand is the costliest option.
explanations.d: Access Analyzer helps detect resource policies that expose access beyond the intended boundary.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A fast-growing startup is reviewing a proposed architecture and finds that the current design does not satisfy IAM and IAM Identity Center. What change should be made?

answers.text: Avoid IAM users for applications that can use roles or federated identity
Use AWS Auto Scaling without health checks so unhealthy instances stay in service
Use an S3 Lifecycle rule as the network control
Use AWS Direct Connect SiteLink as a replacement for Transit Gateway intra-Region peering

explanations.a: Long-lived access keys increase credential management risk.
explanations.b: Without health checks, ASG cannot replace failed instances; HA depends on health-driven replacement.
explanations.c: S3 Lifecycle manages object class transitions; it has no effect on network reachability or traffic.
explanations.d: SiteLink provides any-to-any connectivity between Direct Connect locations; intra-Region VPC-to-VPC uses TGW or peering.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

Use AWS Backup without vault lock to satisfy ransomware-resistant retention

Use VPC interface endpoints to expose internal services to the public internet

explanations.a: Trusted Advisor is a best-practice checker, not a packet-capture tool.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

Use Direct Connect public VIFs to terminate Site-to-Site VPN tunnels
Account for ephemeral return ports when using stateless network ACLs

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

questions.text: A multinational enterprise is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on route tables security groups and network ACLs. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

Centralize all CloudTrail logs in the management account directly

Use Reserved Instances purchased for one Region to cover usage in a different Region

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A global analytics company is preparing a target architecture for a complex AWS organization. Which recommendation best addresses encryption keys and certificate management?

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A multinational enterprise is designing a platform for multiple business units. The requirement focuses on encryption keys and certificate management. Which architecture decision is most appropriate?

answers.text: Use AWS Lambda with no concurrency limits as a DDoS mitigation strategy
Use IAM Identity Center permission sets that grant AdministratorAccess to all OUs

Use a single AWS account for every environment to simplify cost reporting

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
questions.text: A steering committee asks for a recommendation for encryption keys and certificate management after a failed proof of concept exposed governance and operational risks. Which design should the solutions architect choose?

Use AWS Backup vault lock in governance mode to enforce regulatory immutability
Use AWS Private CA for internal certificate hierarchies and private trust domains

explanations.c: Governance mode allows authorized roles to bypass; compliance mode is required for true regulatory immutability.
explanations.d: Private CA supports certificates that are trusted inside the organization.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity

explanations.d: IAM password policy governs human credentials; VPC routing lives in route tables.

questions.name: Design Solutions for Organizational Complexity
